deductions: Page locking/stable reusable pool can remove repeated registration/preparation; it does not by itself reserveIOTLB entries or prevent another device from evicting translations. Actual eviction/PTW delay remains a hypothesis.
Independent streams merely expose scheduling opportunity; they may serialize, and same-stream/event dependence still applies. More streams do not create independently budgeted host IOMMU requesters.
Legal batching/lookahead may improve transfer overhead and locality while increasing memory/credits and delaying other work; evaluate only within source task dependencies and real resource budget.
A large IOMMU leaf can reduce reach pressure only when physical/IOVA alignment/permissions/lifetime permit; no source or current observation establishes such leafs here.
GPU event elapsed covers device work in its scope, notCPU disk-read/pagecache, pin/map, host preparation, independent NVMe progress or whole app finish.
